subject: def-lens-space-surgery-orientation-convention
summary: The reader treated the inclusive two-solid-torus definition as false because L(p,q) notation is restricted to p>0. Those are compatible conventions. Saveliev §1.5 p.25 explicitly includes L(0,1)=S^1 x S^2. Reverted the unnecessary nonzero-intersection restriction to exact pre-reader bytes; all six direct consumers use positive p or separately handle zero and remain sound.

evidence.note: Independent source check and six-consumer review; Saveliev printed p.25.
